summary: Official Koderma district English and Hindi land-record pages establish a local government service route to Jharkhand's Jharbhoomi portal, and official NIC metadata identifies the Jharkhand Bhu-Naksha viewer. No anonymous Kodarma parcel ID-plus-polygon response was verified; no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-11273-kodarma.json. First-party sources establish Koderma district service custody and the Jharkhand viewer route, not open citywide parcel geometry coverage.
requestOutcomes: Koderma district English and Hindi pages and the official NIC implementation page returned successfully. Anonymous TLS-verified requests to Jharbhoomi and the Jharkhand Bhu-Naksha viewer timed out before configuration or service data was returned. No login, credentials, private token, unsafe field request, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS disablement was used.
